claims.statement: Assume the pinned release's exact square matrix multiplication bound. Given X in Z^(N x D), Y in Z^(D x N), D=N^(1/4) integer, entries of O(log N) bits, and a mask represented by rectangles (R_t,C_t) with |R_t|,|C_t| >= D, total cover volume M=sum_t |R_t||C_t| <= N^(15/8), plus an explicit residual list F of size at most N^(7/4-sigma), with M+|F| <= N^(15/8), the distinct requested entries can be computed exactly in O_xi(ND + M D^(1/4+xi) + |F|D + M + |F|) operations over one fixed number field, for any fixed 0<xi<1/4. The rectangle description, input, output, exact coefficient representation, and bit growth are charged; setup acquisition is an additive finite but unbounded A_xi. At xi=1/8 the total bit cost is A_xi + O(N^(2-min(1/32,sigma)) polylog N).
assumptions: The OpenAI Math release theorem at adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a is correct.
A fixed exact rank-decomposition kernel for the chosen epsilon is acquired and represented over a number field.
The supplied rectangle-cover representation and residual list correctly describe W.
Matrix entry bit height is O(log N) for the polylogarithmic bit-overhead bound.
claims.novelty_boundary: The tiling reduction is an elementary consequence of a square matrix-multiplication kernel and is not claimed priority-cleared. It handles a structured rectangle-cover class at D=N^(1/4); it does not handle arbitrary W. Existing arbitrary-mask and complete-block-cover results are not claimed as new.

costs.online_bits_for_log_input_height: online arithmetic times polylog(N), with exact number-field coordinates
costs.mask_representation_bits: O((sum_t(|R_t|+|C_t|)+|F|) log N); rectangle-side condition gives sum_t(|R_t|+|C_t|) <= 2M/D
costs.setup: A_xi acquisition time and S_xi representation size, finite but unbounded and not materialized in this run
costs.precision: exact; no numerical rounding or stability claim

claims.falsifier: An error in the tile identity/cost derivation, a failure of the supplied square-kernel interface over the stated fixed field, or a bit-growth counterexample invalidates the conditional theorem. The finite check only tests indexing on small cases.
claims.next_gate: Acquire and verify an explicit exact base rank decomposition with coefficient field and height bounds; implement the tile compiler and test a complete-component mask at a scale where the recursive kernel is available.
